title: Farmer Carry
summary: A heavy carry with a dumbbell or handle in each hand, for grip, upper traps and trunk stiffness.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for forearms (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly forearms total.
Library rating 0.8 for traps (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.3 for obliques (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly obliques total.
Library rating 0.2 for upper back: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly upper back total.
Library rating 0.2 for abs: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly abs total.

setup.text: Deadlift a heavy dumbbell or handle in each hand and stand tall.
Walk with short, quick steps for a set distance or time.
Set the weights down with a flat back.

form_cues.cue: Shoulders down and back, ribs down. Don't let the weights pull you into a slouch.

mistakes.text: Leaning to one side or shuffling.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: One side at a time, Less spinal loading, Lower loading potential.
Swap sheet: Better isolation, Less systemic fatigue, Less spinal loading.
Swap sheet: Wrist-extensor focus (back of forearm), Less upper-trap work, Better isolation.
Swap sheet: Less upper-trap work, Better isolation, Less systemic fatigue.
